visor.option.EYE_FOV_SCALE.tooltip: Changes fov for both VR eyes. Useful if you have AR glasses with small eye screen
visor.option.MIRROR_DISPLAY.tooltip:
Mirrors image on HMD to separate desktop window.
Can be set to OFF, single or dual hmd-view, first-person undistorted, third person undistorted and mixed reality. The undistorted and mixed reality views have a performance cost.
visor.option.MOVEMENT_MULTIPLIER.tooltip:
Sets a movement multiplier, allowing slower movement than default. This may help reduce locomotion induced simulator sickness.
§cWARNING: May trigger anti-cheat warnings if on a multiplayer server!!
Defaults to standard Minecraft movement (1.0) speed.
visor.option.LEFT_HANDED.tooltip: If enabled, left hand will be as the dominant
visor.option.WORLD_SCALE.tooltip:
Scales the player in the world.
Above one makes you larger
And below one makes you small
And the ones that mother gives you
don't do anything at all.
visor.option.WORLD_ROTATION.tooltip:
Adds extra rotation to your HMD.
More useful bound to a button or changed with the arrow keys.
visor.option.WORLD_ROTATION_INCREMENT.to: How many degrees to rotate when rotating the world.
visor.option.ROOM_MOVEMENT_MULTIPLIER.to:
Multiplies your position in the room by a factor.
Allows you to walk around more, but may cause motion sickness.
visor.option.ROTATION_MODE.tooltip:
The rotation mode

  On what VR device your character head rotation should depend on?
visor.option.MOVEMENT_MODE.tooltip:
The movement mode.

  Controller: Vanilla-like. Move via Offhand joystick
  Teleport: Use both joysticks to teleport to desired location. 
Attention! VR servers can decide what movement mode to support, if it is different from what you chosen, option will be ignored
visor.option.LOW_HEALTH_INDICATOR.toolti: Pulses the screen red, when at low health, to indicate your current health status
visor.option.FREEZE_EFFECT.tooltip: Tints the screen with blue color, when freezing.
visor.option.PUMPKIN_EFFECT.tooltip: Shows Orange Vignette when pumpkin is on head
visor.option.SHADER_GUI_RENDER.tooltip:
Determines how the GUI is rendered with shaders.
  After Shader: renders the GUI without using the shader, best compatibility. (issues with PTGI HRR)
  Translucent: renders the GUI with shader and transparency. (issues with Sildurs Vibrant)
  Opaque: renders the GUI with shader and opaque
visor.option.GUI_SCALE.tooltip: The GUI scale to apply when VR is active.
visor.option.VR_PLAY_MODE.tooltip:
Choose VR Play Mode. 

1) Enabled - VR will be active while headset is on 
2) World Only - VR will be initialized but inactive in main menu and active while in game 
3) Always - VR will be always active 
4) Disabled - VR won't be initialized
visor.overlaySettings.main.widget.edit_o:
Specify overlay id
Has to be unique
visor.overlaySettings.global.widget.upda: If should update options data. Use it if your overlay requires to update state of options, for example position/location formulas that have placeholders
visor.overlaySettings.modelView.widget.t: Teleport demo overlay near your HMDy
visor.overlaySettings.modelView.widget.e:
Emulate current position and rotation
 on demo overlay
visor.overlaySettings.modelView.widget.t: If should update the position state continuously
visor.overlaySettings.modelView.widget.a: If overlay should aim at rotation type

Click to change overlay location based on
Current location of a device it is anchored to.
Disable Emulation before doing so
visor.overlaySettings.modelView.widget.m:
Click and start moving an overlay by hand
Click again to finish
visor.actionBinds.captureInput.guide: Press Start, then press the VR button you want to bind
